newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH SHELL CUTS GASOLINE PRICES, DIESEL UNCHANGED.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH SHELL CUTS GASOLINE PRICES, DIESEL UNCHANGED.

text.p: Royal Dutch/Shell unit Shell Nederland BV said on Friday it would cut its retail prices for gasoline in the Netherlands effective from Monday, August 11.
Petrol prices will fall by 2.0 cents per litre while diesel prices will remain unchanged.
The move reflects changes in international product prices and the value of the dollar against the guilder, the company said.

From Monday the price of premium unleaded gasoline at Shell's self-service stations will fall to 2.26 guilders per litre. The price of super unleaded gasoline goes down to 2.31 guilders and of super with lead substitute to 2.38 guilders.
The recommended price for diesel will remain unchanged at 1.552 guilders per litre.
